subject: Alvion C-suite visit — consolidated EA playbook and travel windows
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Alvion C-suite visit — initial travel windows and EA playbook

Team —

Alvion confirmed an on-site visit for the week of Nov 15–17. They want a focused day with their CEO + CFO and a half-day executive strategy workshop. Key ask from their side: a short onsite CTO roundtable and a closed-door executive dinner on the 15th evening.

I need a tight EA playbook to hand off to their EA (Amelia) and our onsite liaisons. Please pull together the following by EOD tomorrow: 

- Final travel windows for our side (Ben & Marissa): flights, preferred time blocks for meetings (Ben arrives evening Nov 14, Marissa morning Nov 15)
- Venue options for the executive dinner (private dining + AV check) and a contact at the venue
- Secure parking and building access instructions for 6 external visitors and 3 Redwoods
- Short run-of-show for the 15th (8:30–17:00) and a 20-minute CEO briefing deck placeholder
- Draft badge/visitor list for security (we'll exchange with facilities)

Attachments: I put a draft itinerary shell in the Drive (link below). I also flagged a preferred hotel (Oakridge) with a preliminary floorplan.

Priority: make sure our executive morning block is 9:00–11:30 to accommodate the CEO's preference for 2-hour concentrated sessions.

Thanks — Ben

Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0194

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Alvion C-suite visit — initial travel windows and EA playbook

Ben —

Thanks, I pulled together a first-pass pack and attached the working documents. Highlights below:

1) Travel windows (ours)
- Ben Carter: departs SFO Nov 14 5:35pm (SFO -> SJC red-eye blocked), arrival Nov 14 8:05pm local (hotel check-in 20:00).
- Marissa Cole: departs SFO Nov 15 06:50am, arrival 08:25am (prefers morning arrival to prep).
- Tessa Morgan: stand-by but will arrive Nov 15 07:40am to support onsite ops.

2) Venue & logistics
- Oakridge Conference Center: private dining room A (capacity 18). Caterer contacts + AV lead included in attached floorplan (oakridge_floorplan.png).
- Parking: reserved visitor passes for lot B (6 passes). I drafted a visitor_badge_list.csv and flagged the entry code with facilities.

3) Run-of-show (15 Nov) — condensed:
- 08:30 – 09:00: arrival & coffee
- 09:00 – 11:00: executive strategy session (CEO + CFO)
- 11:15 – 12:00: CTO roundtable (invite only)
- 12:00 – 13:00: working lunch
- 13:15 – 15:00: breakout use-case reviews
- 15:15 – 16:30: commercial/finance alignment
- 17:30 – 20:30: executive dinner (Oakridge private dining)

4) Action items for Amelia/Alvion (to confirm): dietary restrictions, guest titles for badges, facility entrance time for delivery crews.

I've attached: alvion_ceo_itinerary_v1.pdf (working itinerary), oakridge_floorplan.png, visitor_badge_list.csv.

I'll reach out to the Oakridge AV lead to confirm microphone and confidence monitors.

Marissa

Marissa Cole | Senior Solutions Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0258

Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 16:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alvion C-suite visit — initial travel windows and EA playbook

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. Confirming the Alvion side:

- Amelia Grant (Alvion EA) will be our onsite point of contact for badges and dietary needs.
- Patrick O'Neal (CFO) will arrive Nov 14 evening; Alvion CEO (Daniel Kwan) arrives Nov 15 morning and prefers a quiet prep room before the 09:00 start.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Is there a secure room where CEO prep (phone calls + notes) can happen between 07:30–08:50? We need a small table and single monitor.
2) Can you confirm whether the AV will support a laptop + iPad mirroring simultaneously? Our CTO wants to show a short demo that pulls in a live dashboard.

I've uploaded our guest titles and passport name spelling to the DocuSign folder (link below). Also attached a short facilities note about freight elevator access for equipment on Nov 14 evening.

Best —
Amelia Grant
Executive Assistant to Daniel Kwan, CEO | Alvion Systems
amelia.grant@alvion.com | +1 415-555-0400

Subject: Re: Alvion C-suite visit — consolidated EA playbook and travel windows

Amelia / Patrick —

Appreciate the confirmation. Quick updates and closed-loop items below: 

- Secure prep room: Oakridge Room 204 reserved 07:00–09:30 on Nov 15 (small table + single monitor + phone dial setup). Marissa confirmed with AV lead; they will test a laptop+iPad mirroring at 17:00 on Nov 14 during load-in.
- AV: Oakridge can do dual mirroring (MacBook HDMI + iPad via AirPlay receiver). We'll bring a USB-C hub and spare MacBook to avoid adapter issues.
- Freight & loading: facilities@oakridge confirmed freight elevator window 17:30–19:00 Nov 14. Label crates with "Redwood / Alvion — Executive Session".
- Visitor badges: Marissa will update the badge CSV and send final names by Nov 12 EOD.

Attachments: final (v2) itinerary will be posted once I get Patrick's travel confirmation; for now I attached the working itinerary (alvion_ceo_itinerary_v1.pdf) and the floorplan for AV planning.

If there are no further asks, Marissa and Tessa will run the final site check on Nov 14 during load-in.

See you onsite — Ben
